description: This file defines the RelationalGroupedDataset class, which provides methods for performing aggregation operations on grouped DataFrames in Apache Spark SQL Connect. It includes methods for creating DataFrames with aggregations, pivoting, and selecting numeric columns, as well as various aggregation functions like count, mean, max, min, sum, etc.

classes.name: RelationalGroupedDataset
classes.description: A class providing aggregation and pivot operations on grouped DataFrames within Spark SQL Connect.

methods.name: toDF
methods.description: Converts aggregation expressions into a new DataFrame with the specified aggregations.

methods.name: selectNumericColumns
methods.description: Selects columns by name, intended for numeric columns, with behavior depending on input types.

methods.name: as
methods.description: Converts the grouped dataset into a KeyValueGroupedDataset with specified key and value encoders.

methods.name: agg
methods.description: Performs aggregation operations with various input formats (strings, columns, maps).

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of rows in each group.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Calculates the mean of specified columns.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Calculates the maximum of specified columns.

methods.name: avg
methods.description: Calculates the average of specified columns.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Calculates the minimum of specified columns.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of specified columns.

methods.name: pivot
methods.description: Creates a pivoted version of the grouped dataset based on a pivot column and optional values.
